stringUnit.value: 尝试次数上限（允许时 0 为不限）
A site-relative image needs the configured media host before interactive rehearsal. The coordinates remain available in review.
站内图片需要配置媒体主机后才能交互预演。仍可在检查视图查看坐标。
These modules can coexist. Turning one off retains its fields for reopening.
这些模块可以叠加使用。关闭模块仍会保留字段，方便重新打开。
Creator-only rehearsal. No publishing, real player records, rewards, or verification.
仅供创作者本地预演，不发布、不写入真实玩家记录、不发奖励，也不代表已验证。
Effects are shown for review only and are never applied to player state.
效果仅供检查，不会写入玩家状态。
Positions use proportions of the original image. Radius is system-managed; this screen reviews the targets without issuing proof.
坐标是原图比例，半径由系统管理。此处仅检查目标位置，不产生通关凭证。
A local selection is not a prediction submission. The merchant reveals the result later.
本地选择不提交竞猜。实际结果由商家稍后揭晓。
Local content rehearsal is available. Only the server can confirm real completion.
可在本地预演内容；真实通关仍由服务端确认。
Authoring is available. Live steps require server-decrypted WeChat exercise data; native device counts are not accepted as proof here.
可以配置。真实计步需要服务端解密微信运动数据，此处不把原生设备计数当作凭证。
Authoring and content preview are available. Route QR binding, scanning, AR and server evidence require separate runtime providers.
可以配置和预览内容。路线二维码绑定、扫码、AR 与服务端凭证需要独立运行能力。
Authoring is available. Camera capture and real vision review are not run in this rehearsal.
可以配置。此次预演不运行相机拍摄或真实视觉审核。
Inspect content and stages locally. Actual availability, daily selection and unlock times use the server clock.
可本地查看内容和阶段；真实开放、每日选择和解锁时间由服务端时钟决定。
Inspect this configuration locally. Team assignment, rankings, records and state changes require the server.
可本地检查配置。真实队伍分配、排行、记录和状态变化需要服务端。
Music is ambient content, not a completion check. This rehearsal reviews the linked track without claiming listening proof.
音乐是氛围内容，不作为通关判定。此预演检查关联曲目，不产生收听凭证。
Does not match in this local rehearsal
Fix configuration or start the rehearsal first
请先修正配置或开始预演
This outcome needs the real runtime provider
此结果需要真实运行服务
An unrecognized field is retained. Submission is blocked to avoid changing its meaning.
已保留未识别字段。为避免改变原意，暂不能提交。
This field has an invalid data type.
此字段的数据类型不正确。
Text exceeds its limit or a required list entry is empty.
文字超出长度限制，或列表必填项为空。
请使用有效且稳定的标识。
Use an HTTPS address or a site-relative path.
请使用 HTTPS 地址或站内路径。
Use a finite number within the displayed limits and related field bounds.
请填写显示范围及关联字段允许范围内的有限数值。
Select a supported option; unknown wire values are retained.
请选择支持的选项；未知协议值仍会保留。
Use a permitted state key, operation and value. sys.luck allows only INC 1–3.
请使用允许的状态键、操作和值。sys.luck 仅允许 INC 1–3。
The number of entries is outside the allowed range.
条目数量不在允许范围内。
Stable identifiers must be unique in their scope.
稳定标识在所属范围内不能重复。
This reference must point to an existing item or match its mode.
此引用必须指向现有条目，且符合所选模式。
End steps have no options; other steps need at least one.
终点不能有选项，其他步骤至少需要一个选项。
The start must have a reachable ending.
从起点必须能够到达一个终点。
Roles and turn order must cover every allowed player count.
角色人数和轮次顺序必须覆盖全部允许人数。
Opening and closing times cannot be equal; overnight windows are allowed.
开始与结束时间不能相同，允许跨夜时段。
Choose the required number of correct answers.
请按所选模式指定正确答案数量。
Targets overlap. Move them farther apart.
目标判定范围重叠，请调整间距。
A 3D model needs AR enabled and a .glb file address.
三维模型需要启用 AR，并使用 .glb 文件地址。
Structured authoring covers all 37 active configuration families. Unknown extensions are retained and block submission; provider-dependent previews explain their limits.
已覆盖全部 37 个有效配置模块的结构化编辑。未知扩展会保留并阻止提交；依赖外部能力的预演会说明限制。
